name: Pakrik Minor
description: Pakrik Minor was a peaceful agriworld in Kanchen sector with fruit and tallgrain farms, resorts, and undeveloped countryside. The cloned Imperial sleeper cell Jenth-44 was located on Pakrik Minor. It was the twin planet of Pakrik Major.
